verdict.why: After a mid-stream WebSocket drop, a cut-off assistant reply is now replaced with the server's copy, so the resulting message state differs.

draft.detail: useAgentChat replaces a cut-off assistant reply with the server's copy after the WebSocket drops mid-stream; AIChatAgent doesn't send that copy yet.
